horoscopes.horoscope: The stars urge you to focus on your finances and savings, and today, you might remain very busy doing just that. But take care, says Ganesha, you don’t want a sulking spouse when you go home. Don’t cancel any plans; go ahead and enjoy that new film. Take care of your partner, advises Ganesha. Exchange some exciting gifts with your sweetheart in the evening to spice up your love life. An adventurous night is on the cards, feels Ganesha. You will be more focussed today in what you want to do. The day is likely to offer you rewards in tangible and intangible manner. There will be lesser restlessness, more happiness and more sense of accomplishment. Health is not an issue for you. Today is an auspicious day for money matters. You are likely to earn reasonably well using your vast experience. At the same time, it is also a favourable day to earn extra penny using your talents. Congratulations! Financial rewards are on the cards at the work front. Though the prizes may be intangible in nature, they may definitely add brownie points to your PMS sheet. You will be glad to see yourself in the good books of your senior authorities.

This day you will have an urge to take a trip, be it a small one. Ganesha sees you enthusiastically making detailed plans and arrangements, arranging for funds and getting in touch with all those you desire to take along. It is possible that you may ultimately scrap your plans and choose to stay at home. However, be sure you’ll be making that trip in due course. You tend to be more practical today. You need to be diplomatic to hold on to a sense of harmony, advises Ganesha. A romantic dinner at a poolside restaurant may break the barriers to communication, says Ganesha. It’s a wonderful day for you to burn calories and stimulate youreself with body building. You can go to the gym, do Yoga, aerobics. It is also the right time to cross those limits which were stopping you so far. Compromise on nothing. Today you will be in mood to spend hard cash on your appearance. But, you will not over-spend. You will find ‘best deal’ or you may bargain hard before buying a service. You will discover your innate qualities and realize your potential. You will be able to speed on tasks and will complete the important projects on time by getting more systematic at the workplace.

You will feel lonely and unwanted today. You will feel the need for someone who can calm your troubled mind. Meditation and yoga will help you calm yourself. It is a good day to receive love from that someone special, says Ganesha. Spending time in the company of your darling will refresh and rejuvenate your senses. Small banter and fun will surely turn on the mood of your loved one. Read out the romantic poems you have written for your sweetheart, suggests Ganesha. Patience will be the name of the game for today. You are likely to remain preoccupied with fruitless discussions and boring meetings in your workplace. Feeling exhausted, spend the evening with your near and dear ones to relax and enjoy. Today you will waste your funds on things that are not essential. You may also spend money on a member of the opposite sex, traveling and transient pleasures, or on some unforeseen event. Your efforts may get channelized in the wrong direction. Hence, Ganesha advises you to ensure that your hard work doesn’t go in vain. Be very careful of your duties and responsibilities, says Ganesha. Getting helps from the right person will keep you on the track.

You will succeed in a new venture and will brim with radiance and energy. Ganesha says this is the best time for get-together and kindle contact with friends and relatives. Emotions run deep and you may even burn a hole in your pocket by buying goodies to please your lover. You may be driven by fantasies now. Listen to your lover while presenting a deep thought, suggests Ganesha. Don’t do all the work yourself. Delegate it to the people whom you trust. This is important to save your energy. You may also make you friends, who could be of help to you in some way or the other. You will be successful in your endeavor of pleasing that person if you spend money today. This is also highly favourable day to exchange gifts. Stars are in your favour to win someone’s heart by spending! Your investigative tendencies will put you on a 007 mission to solve technical quests. Thinking about talking to senior authorities? Ganesha gives you the green signal as you are confident to prove your point.

You will look to give your house a new appearance by decorating it or undertaking some renovation projects. You will make the best out of waste and produce some truly marvellous pieces of art for improving the ambience of your nest. You will be able to save up on some money. Laudable, says Ganesha. Your loved one will give you the emotional support you need. A charming message from your beloved awaits you. At the end of the evening, your partner will be happy for your dedication and commitment, feels Ganesha. You will have a positive mindset today, which will make you manage everything in a better manner. Your mood too will be very good due to accomplishment. You will also enjoy excellent health and will do lot of tasks with confidence. Take up more or good assignments in order to earn money. Short term benefits as are not foreseen, but be patient. Those dealing in stock market may not be very happy with the market scenario. Important works will occupy your mind today. You will be ambitious and ultra-determined to achieve in order to get praise from higher authorities. You won’t waste any time chatting and messaging. Ganesha foresees positive changes in your work profile.

You will excel remarkably in whatever work you prefer to engage yourself in today. Ganesha says your aspiration to start a business endeavour in a foreign country will bear fruit. To considerably enhance your self-image, it is necessary to make required improvements in your personal appearance. Your romance will suddenly turn to never-ending lust today. Your loved one will be happy to see your passionate mood. It’s not the right time to discuss any domestic issues or responsibilities. Enjoy the day to your heart’s content, says Ganesha. You will be happy and in good health today. Luck will be on your side. If you travel for work or for joy, you will derive lot of happiness. You will be able to motivate others you yourself will be self motivated. This is a good day to sit with your bank statement and see the source of income vs expenses, to have better idea about where you stand and to have an overview or projection of the future. Things will go smoothly at the workplace today. You will delight your boss with your cheerful outlook. It’s a perfect day for making calculations as you are getting more cautious, realistic and decisive about the work you do.

Ganesha says that on the work front you may be in the midst of meetings or negotiations, which will work out favorably for you. This will help ease your tension and you will feel mentally free. Today you will feel more vibrant and active too and hence will be able to get more done. You will be able to strike a perfect balance in your social and personal life. Your love life will blossom as you will spend more quality time with your sweetheart. Even if you stay far away from your loved one, you will keep interacting with your partner. This is not a good day to carry out physically exhaustive activities. You should maintain your energy levels by saving energy in whichever way you can. Also you should try to increase your energy by taking more protein and vitamin rich food. Today is not too auspicious for financial matters. You should not invest money aggressively, advises Ganesha. Finances are likely to make you worried because long-term gains are not visible. Lessons you have learned from your seniors or bosses will guide you in performing better, smarter and faster at work today. You will be busy solving complex issues since you have to shoulder huge responsibilities.

According to Ganesha, your new business venture is likely to keep you on toes today. You may even neglect your personal life to meet expectations at work. A feeling of disappointment may surround you as things do not go according to planning and your efforts may go in vain. No pains, no gains reminds Ganesha. You may feel courageous in love life. The moral support and positive vibes you receive from your loved one shall make this world a better place to live. Your spouse will listen to your words and you will turn up the heat on your lover. You need to balance work and life today. If you do excessive work, your body will start reacting negatively to it. Do your bit in the best possible manner and when you can’t stretch, say ‘no’ to excessive work and postpone it till tomorrow. You will be spending money on your life-partner or beloved today. You may also wish to spend a bit on showing off to the society, how much you own or how stable you are financially. Stressful time at work is on the cards today. You may not be able to work the whole day. A perfect balance between professional and personal like will help you come out of the stressful situation.

You are in a dilemma today. You may find yourself standing at crossroads, and your decision power does not seem to help you much, says Ganesha. You are likely to become controversy’s favourite child; this may add fuel to the fire. Be wise, and take guidance of experienced people. Though you may feel happy for your loved one, you may not spend adequate time with him/her. Trust your lover and spend some wonderful time with them, advises Ganesha. You will not sit idle today. You will plan your work in such a way that your energy is used properly. Health-wise, it’s an average day so don’t push yourself too much. Give time to yourself too and spend some time in seclusion. Ganesha feels that today you will be trying to be more practical about money matters and will be able to control impulsive buying. Though this may be hard for you, it will not be impossible. A complimentary day for you, predicts Ganesha. Compliments from your boss will inspire you to get more dedicated to works than ever. You may not sit relaxed for a moment and utilize your time at the office in the best possible manner.

God helps those who help themselves, likewise, your sincere efforts will be paid off well, today. If you’re dealing with shares and stocks, it maybe your day, today. Your life partner will proved to be lucky for your success, so give him/her the credit he/she deserves, suggests Ganesha. You will be able to develop positive understanding with your partner, feels Ganesha. Creative ways in which you will express your feelings will make your partner fall in love with you all over again. The cosmic undercurrents feel that you tend to be flamboyant to please your lover. You will be in good health today. You will be getting good results of your efforts. It is also a good day to eat something you like but you should take care and avoid over eating. If you over eat, it may upset your stomach. You shall be in a very materialistic mood today. However, you will not spend money without thinking. You will value each penny earned. Today, you may avoid the speculative market. Your professional life may offer you a plethora of opportunities today, says Ganesha. It’s a good time for marketers and CEOs to extend products or service portfolios and to expand the current business. Put in more efforts to get incentives and perks at the workplace.

Today is a day of communication and associations. While at a family gathering, you will enjoy chatting nineteen to the dozen! But at work, you may be left teaching, explaining, negotiating, co-ordinating and arranging meetings. A productive but draining day, says Ganesha. Today, you are in a mood to spend time with your family members, relatives or friends. After you call it a day at the office, you will be in a hurry to rush home to have a wonderful evening with them. Today you may be in a mood to work from home or you may not wish to spend more time at office. Of late, you have taxed yourself enough due to various tasks so now is the time to give yourself enough rest. You will be interested in investing money in property or vehicle. It’s a favourable day to check out some luxurious houses. If you are satisfied with your current house, you may think about a new vehicle. Focusing on your shortcomings can help you improve your skills. Today, you may find yourself contemplating over some matters related to work. Working on your perfection will be the key to success.

Compromise is the name of the game when it comes to relationships, and you are adept at it. You realise the importance of losing an argument to win over a heart, and do so with panache. Indeed, this is an area where others emulate you, says Ganesha. You may suffer from mood swings. You will be unpredictable today. Be cautious as it may leave your partner puzzled. Don’t tell lies to your partner as it will turn the situation more complex. Health should not be a problem for you today. However, you should not allow your mind to impact your health. Generally you think from the heart but today your mind will also be equally active and you will be applying logic to things. You are likely to take financial risks today. You may want to invest money behind some project or may be willing to take some time out for something that you have been trying to establish since long. Your creative zone will be very much emphasized today, so you may change your modus operandi, which will help you handle every aspect of work very easily. Be a bit flexible and adventurous to refuel your creative juice.
